about_the_game:
This is a demo of the House Builder 2 game. You will be able to try 3 missions in which the player will face construction tasks - from repairing a fence to building a full-size house.

Features of the demo:

  • Demo last roughly about 40 minutes but no one limits you to only completing tasks. The open world of the game is waiting to be explored

  • Open World

  • Customizing the house with paint and furniture

  • Day and night cycle

MAIN FEATURES OF HOUSE BUILDER 2

🛠️ PREPARING FOR WORK

Gear up and get ready—every job starts with the right tools and a plan! Firstly, you need to look at what you need for your next construction. Go to the local warehouse, buy it, and load it on the truck.

🚚 GETTING TO WORK

Don’t be late or you can miss your ride. Load up, hit the road, and make sure everything gets delivered. On-site, before the job, you must unload all the stuff needed for the construction.

🌍 TRUE OPEN WORLD

Unleash your creativity in a sprawling open world teeming with possibilities. Explore it, find the place you want to work, and begin your job. The vast landscape is your canvas – shape it to your liking!

🔨 ADVANCED BUILDING MECHANICS

Experience the next level of building simulation with advanced mechanics that offer more precision and control. Utilize a wide range of tools and materials to construct aesthetically pleasing and structurally sound homes. Take on challenging missions, complete building contracts, and unlock new tools and upgrades as you progress. House Builder 2 offers a dynamic gameplay experience that keeps you engaged and motivated to build and explore.

🌈 STUNNING COLORFUL GRAPHICS

Dive into a visually captivating world where vibrant colors bring every detail to life. House Builder 2 offers a feast for the eyes, from the lush landscapes to the intricate interiors, ensuring every building project feels unique and beautiful.

Get ready to embark on the building adventure of a lifetime with House Builder 2. Whether you're a seasoned architect or a novice builder, there's something here for everyone. Grab your tools and start crafting your dream home today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5-760 (4*2800), AMD Phenom II
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760, AMD R7-260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
